from PIL import Image, ImageFilter
import numpy as np
from collections import deque
a=np.asarray(Image.open('augen_blink/blink_000.png').convert('RGBA'))
b=np.asarray(Image.open('augen_blink/blink_006.png').convert('RGBA'))
d=np.max(np.abs(a[:,:,:3].astype(np.int16)-b[:,:,:3].astype(np.int16)),axis=2)
# Canonical glow alpha gives a hard measured eye-anchor, then expand only enough for lids.
g=np.asarray(Image.open('augen_gaze/rotglow_tracking_master.png').convert('RGBA'))[:,:,3]>0
gy,gx=np.where(g); gb=(int(gx.min()),int(gy.min()),int(gx.max())+1,int(gy.max())+1)
fx0=max(0,gb[0]-35); fy0=max(0,gb[1]-35); fx1=min(d.shape[1],gb[2]+35); fy1=min(d.shape[0],gb[3]+35)
print('GLOW_BBOX',gb,'FOCUS_BBOX',(fx0,fy0,fx1,fy1),'FOCUS_FRAC',round(((fx1-fx0)*(fy1-fy0))/d.size,6))
print('DIFF_GLOBAL_Q',*[round(float(x),2) for x in np.quantile(d,[.5,.75,.9,.95,.99,1])])
print('DIFF_FOCUS_Q',*[round(float(x),2) for x in np.quantile(d[fy0:fy1,fx0:fx1],[.5,.75,.9,.95,.99,1])])
def comps(mask):
 h,w=mask.shape; seen=np.zeros_like(mask,bool); out=[]
 for y in range(h):
  for x in range(w):
   if not mask[y,x] or seen[y,x]: continue
   q=[(y,x)]; seen[y,x]=1; pts=[]
   while q:
    yy,xx=q.pop(); pts.append((yy,xx))
    for dy in (-1,0,1):
     for dx in (-1,0,1):
      if not (dx or dy): continue
      ny,nx=yy+dy,xx+dx
      if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and mask[ny,nx] and not seen[ny,nx]: seen[ny,nx]=1; q.append((ny,nx))
   ys=[p[0] for p in pts]; xs=[p[1] for p in pts]
   out.append((len(pts),(min(xs),min(ys),max(xs)+1,max(ys)+1)))
 return sorted(out,reverse=True)
for thr in [20,30,40,50,70,90,120,160]:
 m=(d>=thr); focus=np.zeros_like(m); focus[fy0:fy1,fx0:fx1]=1; m &= focus
 # close small holes / join local eyelid texture, but never expand beyond measured focus.
 im=Image.fromarray((m*255).astype('uint8')).filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(5)).filter(ImageFilter.MinFilter(5)); mc=np.asarray(im)>0; mc &= focus
 cs=comps(mc)
 print('THR',thr,'RAW_PIX',int(m.sum()),'CLOSED_PIX',int(mc.sum()),'COMP_COUNT',len(cs),'TOP',cs[:8])
 # tight union of components >=25 px; this rejects isolated photographic grain.
 keep=[c for c in cs if c[0]>=25]
 if keep:
  x0=min(c[1][0] for c in keep); y0=min(c[1][1] for c in keep); x1=max(c[1][2] for c in keep); y1=max(c[1][3] for c in keep)
  print('THR_UNION_GE25',thr,(x0,y0,x1,y1),'COMPONENTS',len(keep),'PIXELS',sum(c[0] for c in keep))
# row/column energy in focus to see eyelid bands rather than rectangle noise.
f=d[fy0:fy1,fx0:fx1].astype(float)
for qname,arr in [('ROW_MEAN',f.mean(axis=1)),('ROW_P90',np.quantile(f,.9,axis=1)),('COL_MEAN',f.mean(axis=0)),('COL_P90',np.quantile(f,.9,axis=0))]:
 idx=np.argsort(arr)[-12:][::-1]; base=fy0 if qname.startswith('ROW') else fx0
 print(qname,[(int(i+base),round(float(arr[i]),2)) for i in idx])
print('SCOPE=READ_ONLY_OPEN_CLOSED_EYE_COMPONENTS')
